projects.burankatop.title: BurankaTop
projects.burankatop.description: BurankaTop is a community-driven platform for Genshin Impact theorycrafting. It ranks team DPS, showcases character builds, and highlights F2P-friendly compositions, with dedicated leaderboards for featured meta teams such as Odette and Sandrone. A dark, cinematic interface paired with SEO, structured data, and web analytics makes the data easy to explore and share.
projects.burankatop.note: Raised from idea to launch with the help of an LLM — medium technical complexity.
